morgan.h: Quick favor — need a short profiling pass to validate the fused-kernel change merged yesterday. Can someone run nsys + torch.profiler on a Dedicated A5000 node and upload traces to S3? I only need a small, well-instrumented run (cold + steady) so we can compare flamegraphs.
sasha: I can take this. Which model/config and seq len? Want me to run batch 1 and 8?
morgan.h: Yep — run on opt-1.3b fp16 (checkpoint at /models/ops/opt-1.3b-fp16). Seq len 8192 (full), do batch sizes 1 and 8. Protocol:
- Cold: 3 iterations
- Warm: 20 iterations
- Total iters ~ 30
- Capture both nsys trace (nvtx,cuda) and torch.profiler traces for tensorboard

Example nsys command (adapt path/node names):
```bash
nsys profile --output=/tmp/nsys_1932104321 --trace=nvtx,cuda --sample=none \
  --force-overwrite --capture-range=nvtx --capture-range-begin=iteration_0 \
  --capture-range-end=iteration_end \
  python run_infer.py --model /models/ops/opt-1.3b-fp16 \
    --seq_len 8192 --batch 1 --iters 30
```

Torch profiler snippet to drop into run_infer (so we get per-iteration traces):
```py
from torch.profiler import profile, schedule, ProfilerActivity, tensorboard_trace_handler

with profile(
    schedule=schedule(wait=2, warmup=3, active=20),
    activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA],
    on_trace_ready=tensorboard_trace_handler('/tmp/torch_prof_1932104321'),
    record_shapes=True,
    with_stack=True,
):
    for i in range(30):
        infer_step()
```

Upload instructions:
- Put artifacts in s3://redwood-profiling/ingest/1932104321/<node>/
- Include nsys report (.qdrep/.nsys-rep), cooked flamegraph svg, and torch profiler directory
- Sanitize inputs: strip/anon prompt tokens. Don't include raw PII.

jonas: Quick note — run the kv-cache sanitizer before upload: tools/sanitize_kv.py --strip-inputs --anon-tokens. It removes prompt bytes and normalizes attention keys.

rita: If you hit OOM on batch=8, drop to batch=4 and add --max-seq 1024 for a smoke test. Also nsys --sample=none is important or files blow up.

sasha: Running this now on dedicated-a5000-03. ETA ~09:00 PST. I'll attach node name and raw filenames when done.

ci-bot: Started artifact listener for run 1932104321 — will validate uploads and checksum.

sasha: Done. Uploaded to s3://redwood-profiling/ingest/1932104321/dedicated-a5000-03/

morgan.h: Awesome, thanks Sasha. I'll run the quick flamegraph pass and compare against the baseline (1909000000). Will ping with regressions or diffs. :thumbsup:

sasha: cool — ping me if you want the larger batch runs later.

jonas: one request — include the python commandline (env + CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES) in the upload metadata so we can reproduce exactly.

rita: Also paste the exact git sha in the scrub_report so we can correlate.

morgan.h: Will do both. If we see anything suspicious (KV miss patterns or extra cuda memcpy hotspots), I'll open a mini-bisect thread. Thanks everyone.
